description: Retrieve a full compliance profile for a single EPA-regulated facility by EPA Registry ID. Returns facility metadata, ECHO's facility-level compliance status, a per-statute (CAA, CWA, RCRA, SDWA, and others ECHO tracks) compliance summary, the newest 100 inspections and other compliance monitoring records from the last five years, five years of formal enforcement actions with penalties, the latest TRI release total, and the facility's TRI facility IDs for epa_get_tri_releases. Use epa_search_facilities to discover Registry IDs. For area-level enforcement discovery use epa_search_violations instead.

registry_id.description: EPA FRS Registry ID for the facility (obtained from epa_search_facilities)

name: epa_get_facility

airCompliance.description: Clean Air Act status. Present only when programs.air is true and ECHO reports a CAA status.

programId.description: ICIS-Air ID when the facility has exactly one; absent when it has several

status.description: Current Clean Air Act compliance status

statusDate.description: End of the latest quarter the status covers (MM/DD/YYYY)

compliance.description: Facility-level noncompliance count from ECHO's facility search record. Absent when ECHO reports none or the facility search request fails.

mediaStatusCode.description: Not populated: no ECHO response this tool reads carries a media status code.

mediaStatusDescription.description: Not populated: no ECHO response this tool reads carries a media status description. See complianceStatus and programCompliance.

quartersInViolation.description: Quarters (of the last 12) in which any program found the facility in noncompliance

complianceStatus.description: ECHO's facility-level compliance status, the same value epa_search_facilities returns (e.g. "Significant Violation"). Absent when ECHO assigns none, as for TRI-only facilities, or when ECHO's facility search request fails (the notice field then says so).

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `facility_not_found`: ECHO has no facility for the given Registry ID. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

formalActions.description: Formal enforcement actions over the 5-year window, newest first

actionType.description: Type of formal enforcement action, e.g. "Administrative Order"

caseId.description: Enforcement case identifier; absent when ECHO records the action without one, as for RCRA and SDWA actions

leadAgency.description: Lead agency: EPA, State, or Local

settlementDate.description: Settlement date of the enforcement case (MM/DD/YYYY)

inspections.description: Inspections, evaluations, investigations, and other compliance monitoring records over the 5-year window, newest first; at most 100 (inspectionsTotal gives the full count)

items.description: Single inspection or other compliance monitoring record

activityType.description: Inspection or evaluation type, e.g. "FCE On-Site", "PCE Stack Test", "Compliance Evaluation Inspection"

category.description: Kind of record, e.g. "Inspection/Evaluation", "Compliance Investigation", "Information Request", "Offsite Record Review"; absent for RCRA and SDWA records

description.description: Finding ECHO records for the inspection, when it records one

leadAgency.description: Lead agency: EPA, State, or Local

sourceId.description: Program ID inspected, e.g. an ICIS-Air ID, NPDES permit, RCRA handler ID, or public water system ID

inspectionsTotal.description: Compliance monitoring records in ECHO's 5-year history for this facility; inspections lists the newest 100 when there are more

notice.description: Present when ECHO's facility search request failed, so complianceStatus and compliance are missing; every other field comes from the facility's detailed report.

programCompliance.description: ECHO's per-statute enforcement and compliance summary. Empty when the facility is in no compliance-tracked program, as for TRI-only facilities.

items.description: One statute's enforcement and compliance summary

currentStatus.description: Current compliance status under this statute, e.g. "No Violation Identified"

formalActions.description: Formal enforcement actions over the 5-year window

informalActions.description: Informal enforcement actions over the 5-year window

inspections.description: Inspections or full compliance evaluations over the 5-year window

quartersInNoncompliance.description: Quarters in noncompliance over the 3-year window (of 12)

quartersInSignificantNoncompliance.description: Quarters in significant noncompliance over the 3-year window (of 12)

statute.description: Statute ECHO summarizes, e.g. CAA, CWA, RCRA, SDWA, TSCA, EPCRA

totalPenaltiesInDollars.description: Penalties from formal enforcement actions over the 5-year window, in dollars

programs.description: Program registration flags, from the ECHO systems in the facility's detailed report

air.description: Has an ICIS-Air record (Clean Air Act stationary-source compliance). Emissions-inventory, risk-management, and greenhouse-gas reporting entries alone do not count.

rcra.description: Has an RCRAInfo record (RCRA hazardous waste handler)

sdwa.description: Has an SDWIS record (Safe Drinking Water Act public water system)

tri.description: Has a Toxics Release Inventory record — true exactly when triFacilityIds is non-empty

water.description: Has an ICIS-NPDES record (Clean Water Act discharge permit)

triFacilityIds.description: 15-character TRI facility IDs recorded for this facility, most recently reported first — pass one as facility_id to epa_get_tri_releases for per-chemical releases. A site can carry several from successive operators. Empty when the facility has no TRI record.

triReleasesTransfersInLbs.description: Total TRI on- and off-site releases and transfers in pounds for triReleasesTransfersYear, ECHO's latest TRI year for this facility. Absent when ECHO holds no TRI history for it.

waterCompliance.description: Clean Water Act status. Present only when programs.water is true and ECHO reports a CWA status.

permitId.description: NPDES permit ID when the facility has exactly one; absent when it has several

programId.description: Not populated: the CWA program ID is the NPDES permit ID, returned as permitId.

status.description: Current Clean Water Act compliance status

title: Get EPA Facility Compliance Profile
